The last two weeks

Kept on this phone, just for you. It is a keepsake, not a medical chart — please don't compare one day against another. Every baby has quiet days and busy days. If his movements ever feel genuinely different or reduced to you, don't wait and don't count first: ring your midwife or the maternity unit straight away, any hour. They would always rather you called.
